purpose: Fresh-document confirmation of fixed-source recipient compactness after exposed cross-configuration development
mean_constants_source_split: unchanged original independent mean; no estimation in this run
threshold_source_split: Source applicability chosen on prior development and frozen before this corpus; no new-data tuning
resource_lease: cpu-heavy resource_manager.run; bounded ~40-100MB range reads and small local tokens, no disk monopoly
scope_limit: Fresh calibration-hash-bucket documents, excluded by ID and exact text hash against all short/long SAE training and validation, original paired splits, and every previous F4 corpus. Four development-fixed source queries, all8positive/negative requests, targets1/2 excluding ownseed. This is new-data confirmation of a restricted cross-configuration claim, not a five-seed long SAE suite. Original paired audit sealed.
budget: 65536tokens; <=300s/~40-100MB revision-pinned range sampling after existing-storage check. Existing code/raw extraction<=128LMforwards/120s numerical+90s load/~500MB. Source-only cases<=120s CPU; encode long SAEs only on selected intervention rows. Atmost8selectedcases/14targetcasepairs/10methods<=164causalforwards/180s numerical+90s load. No refit, new training, paid resource, or whole-disk monopoly.

frozen_scope.decision_scope: Four source queries fixed from the entire recipient development panel, including original1230positive counterexample; all positive/negative requests. Keep original source-only first selected supported recipient else first supported; class-compatible opposite-condition first-n donor positions with maximum source difference energy and original tie rule. Recompute applicability, evaluate selected supported pairs only, record every missing/rejected request. No target endpoint selection or new-data fitting.

probability_endpoints.primary: intervention_positions with valid within-document observed next token
probability_endpoints.secondary: union of same-document positions downstream from an intervention, excludes EOS predictions and final unavailable token
probability_endpoints.kl: sum KL(P_source||P_candidate) / sum KL(P_source||P_baseline); float64 log-softmax; denominator <=1e-12*positions yields null
probability_endpoints.nll: observed next-token NLL intervention-minus-baseline vector; report signed means, RMS and normalized squared vector error; source squared energy <=1e-12*positions yields null
probability_endpoints.scope: joint multi-position interventions, not independent position attribution; secondary suffix may condition on preceding packed documents but no later document positions scored

frozen_scope.primary_comparison: long128_top16 vs readout_top16 on primary KL ratio and observed NLL delta squared error; all other methods and secondary endpoints retained

recipient_fit.note: Replay beta, fixed top16 support and single atom/coefficient exactly; no new-data refit.
